fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Étude expérimentale comparative : pipeline BERT+GCN pour tri de revues systématiques, cinq conditions comparées.
fields.quote: Papers are encoded via frozen PubMedBERT embeddings and a 2-layer RGCNConv over a kNN similarity graph. The spectral engine applies two complementary uncertainty tests (algebraic radical and categorical paradox) to classify each paper as INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, or MAYBE.

fields.label: Données
fields.quote: While the 8 datasets span different drug classes with varying inclusion rates and sizes, all are within the biomedical domain.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Les modèles évalués incluent GPT‑5.4‑mini, GPT‑4.1‑mini, GPT‑4o, Claude 4 Sonnet, Llama 3 et Mistral.
fields.quote: The main matrix evaluates gpt-5.4-mini across 8 datasets, with a 3-dataset single-seed pilot for gpt-4.1-mini (Section 6.8). Results may differ for larger frontier models (GPT-4o, Claude 4 Sonnet) or open-source alternatives (Llama 3, Mistral).

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: Les résultats montrent que la livraison full‑context améliore significativement F1 de +0,011 (p=0,008) et WSS@95 de +0,050 (p=0,039), tout en conservant le rappel. La stratégie MAYBE‑only obtient le meilleur rappel moyen (0,92) et AUC‑ROC (0,54) à un coût 1,05× celui de baseline.
fields.quote: Full-context delivery yields statistically significant improvements on the two metrics that matter most for screening efficiency: F1 (∆= +0.011, p = 0.008) and WSS@95 (∆= +0.050, p = 0.039). In a screening workflow processing tens of thousands of records, a five-percentage-point reduction in the screening burden at fixed 95% recall is operationally meaningful. Decision-only and two-pass also produce significant F1 gains (p = 0.008).
